title: 第258章 报复你们也配第257章 装什么大尾巴狼
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 王渊像条死狗一样，四仰八叉的瘫倒在冰冷的地板上。
他两大腿此刻已经扭曲成了一个诡异的角度，森白的骨茬甚至直接刺破了裤腿，鲜血流了一地。
王大山慢慢的收回了脚，他连看都没多看地上的鲜血一眼，只是居高临下的俯视着地上来回打滚的王渊，嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的笑意。
“怎么样？”
“被废掉的滋味，爽不爽？”
王大山微微弯下腰，眼神里透着一股子让人胆寒的冷漠。
“刚才你不是嚷嚷着要自杀吗？”
“来，别停。”
“要是觉得这点痛还不够，要不要我再帮帮你的忙？直接送你上路？”
瘫在血泊里的王渊听到这犹如恶魔般的低语。整个人狠狠的打了个哆嗦。
他的脸现在惨白的像是一张纸，没有半点血色。
王渊双手死死抱着自己那两条已经彻底残废的大腿，疼的眼泪和鼻涕糊了满脸。
哪里还有半点之前嚣张跋扈的大少爷架势。
“不要！”
“不要帮忙了！”
王渊疯狂的摇着头，声音嘶哑的嚎叫着。
“我不自杀了！我再也不寻死了！”
“我错了，我真的错了，求求你放过我吧！”
他是真的怕了。
直到这一刻他才彻底的明白，眼前这个被找回来的真少爷，根本就不是什么任人揉捏的软柿子。
这分明个杀人不眨眼的活阎王！
王大山看着王渊这副痛哭流涕的窝囊废模样，非常满意的点了点头。
“早点认怂不就好了，非得敬酒不吃吃罚酒。”
王大山直起腰，他转过头将目光慢悠悠的投向了站在一旁的李清玉。
此时的李清玉，早就被吓的魂飞魄散了。
她死死的靠在背后的红木桌子上，浑身上下抖的就像是筛糠一样。
李清玉伸出一根手指指着王大山。
她的声音颤抖的甚至连不成一句完整的话。
李清玉瞪大了眼睛，看着地上的鲜血，满脸的不可置信。
她怎么也没想到，王大山竟然真的敢当着她的面，下这种死手！
不仅是没有任何的忧郁，直接果断的废了她当做心肝宝贝一样养大的儿子！
content_en:
Wang Yuan lay sprawled on the cold floor like a dead dog.
His thighs were now twisted into a weird angle, and the white bone stubble even directly pierced his trouser legs, causing blood to flow all over the floor.
Wang Dashan slowly retracted his feet. He didn't even glance at the blood on the ground. He just looked down at Wang Yuan who was rolling back and forth on the ground, with a cold smile on his lips.
"How's it going?"
"Does it feel good to be abolished?"
Wang Dashan bent down slightly, with a chilling indifference in his eyes.
"Didn't you just shout that you were going to commit suicide?"
"Come on, don't stop."
"If you think this pain is not enough, do you want me to help you again? Send you on your way directly?"
Wang Yuan, who was paralyzed in a pool of blood, heard this demonic whisper. The whole person shivered violently.
His face was now as pale as a piece of paper, without any blood.
Wang Yuan hugged his two completely disabled thighs with both hands, and his face was covered with painful tears and snot.
There is no trace of the arrogant and domineering young master's attitude before.
"No!"
"Don't help!"
Wang Yuan shook his head crazily and howled hoarsely.
"I won't commit suicide! I won't seek death anymore!"
"I was wrong, I was really wrong, please let me go!"
He was really scared.
It wasn't until this moment that he fully understood that the recovered true young master in front of him was not a soft persimmon who could be manipulated.
This is clearly a living king of hell who kills without blinking an eye!
Wang Dashan looked at Wang Yuan's crying wimp and nodded with great satisfaction.
"It would be better if you give in earlier. If you don't have a toast, you will be fined."
Wang Dashan straightened up, turned his head and slowly cast his gaze at Li Qingyu who was standing aside.
At this time, Li Qingyu was scared to death.
She leaned firmly on the mahogany table behind her, her whole body shaking like chaff.
Li Qingyu pointed at Wang Dashan with a finger.
Her voice was so trembling that she couldn't even form a complete sentence.
"You...you..."
Li Qingyu's eyes widened, looking at the blood on the ground with disbelief on his face.
She never expected that Wang Dashan would actually dare to do such a deadly trick in front of her!
Not only did she not feel any melancholy, but she directly and decisively killed the son she had raised as her darling!
title_en: Chapter 258 You are worthy of revenge. Chapter 257 Why are you pretending to be a big-tailed wolf?
